lead.claim: Consider NMES to improve lower limb function in post-stroke patients.
lead.context: A systematic review and meta-analysis found neuromuscular electrical stimulation improved several measures of lower limb mobility and daily activities in post-stroke patients.

supporting.claim: For stroke balance, is whole-body vibration most beneficial?
supporting.context: A network meta-analysis of stroke rehabilitation interventions found whole-body vibration most beneficial for balance, while other exercise types improved walking endurance.

supporting.claim: No single observational gait tool is fully recommended for neurological populations.
supporting.context: A COSMIN systematic review and meta-analysis found no observational gait analysis tool was fully recommended for use in neurological populations, though some showed potential for stroke.

supporting.claim: Balance confidence and objective balance are distinct in chronic stroke.
supporting.context: A secondary analysis of adults with chronic stroke found small correlations between balance confidence and objective balance and gait measures.

supporting.claim: Can machine learning predict peak ACL force from biomechanical parameters?
supporting.context: An interpretable machine learning model demonstrated high accuracy in predicting peak ACL force during side-cutting maneuvers in male football and basketball athletes.
